description: Adds one item to a project's Sourcing tab. fields holds the company's own Sourcing columns by key (see project: item_fields), e.g. size, qty. photo_url adds a picture (PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB). Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

fields.description: Sourcing columns by key, e.g. {"size": "84 in", "qty": "2"}

photo_url.description: Public https address of a picture

name: add_project_item
title: Add a project item
